What this means for your family

This document gives families an institution-specific registration to match against the address and service being considered.

Issuer
Hyderabad District · Disability Empowerment Department
Certificate reference
32 of 2024
Stated validity
17 December 2024 – 31 March 2027
Scope
The institution and address named on the certificate

What this supports

The supplied certificate records the named institution’s district registration under Section 51 of the RPwD Act.

Scope & limits

The record covers its listed institution and location. Face-date validity does not confirm that no later change, suspension or cancellation has occurred.
